entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [wasm][R2R] GC hole: ref loaded from a local and held across a call is not spilled, goes stale after a compacting GC #131373
  • [iOS] CoreCLR R2R is dramatically slower than Mono AOT: 60 FPS drops to 7.4 FPS in real-time game rendering #131371
  • [Android] Periodic frame rate drops (60→54 FPS; 6-10 consecutive frames c. every 5 seconds) with CoreCLR on .NET 11 — regression from Mono on .NET 10 #131370
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: System.Net.Security.Tests.TlsSessionTests.SslStreamServer_RejectsClientCert_ClientObservesAlert on Nativ [Content truncated due to length] #131368
  • MemoryExtensions: multi-value IndexOfAny/IndexOfAnyExcept/LastIndexOfAny/LastIndexOfAnyExcept missing int/long fast paths #131367
  • cdac: use debugger-conventional HRESULTs in the data-target adapters #131364
    11.0.0

Closed

  • [Mono]: Stop emitting cold section method load EventPipe events for AOT methods. #119811
    11.0.0
  • Tensors and Complex<T> issues #131344

  • SIMD store coalescing and atomicity guarantees #76503

    11.0.0

  • Self contained application does not start when the current directory is the application directory and current directory containing {appname}.runtimeconfig.json but does not contain {appname}.deps.json #64517
    Future
